name: FFS_REPORT_SCHEDULE
description: Used to store schedule for automatic generation of reports.

columns.name: REPORT_ID
columns.description: Id of the report for the scheduled report.

columns.name: STARTDATE
columns.description: Date at which the scheduled report starts.

columns.name: ENDDATE
columns.description: Schedule period end of the scheduled report.

columns.name: TIME_FROM
columns.description: Start time of report send period.

columns.name: MONTHDAY
columns.description: Week days set for the scheduled report.

columns.name: RECUR_WEEK
columns.description: Recurring week for the scheduled report.

columns.name: EMAIL
columns.description: Email id to which the scheduled report is to be sent.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Id Of The Resource, Whose Report To Be Sent.

columns.name: REPORT_TYPE
columns.description: File Type For Exporting The Report.

columns.name: TO_FILE
columns.description: Flag Set To Indicate Whether Report Can Be Exported. The Default Is 0.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
